points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Curated CMake/source submission and documented CLI exist; no clean evaluator build was needed for the recorded result finding.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Source/CLI is documented in the curated submission; no contrary command-path evidence was recorded.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Rubric evidence identifies modular solver source and interfaces.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal wrapper or existing-solver executable evidence was recorded; external comparison is outside the trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: The eight required cases are delivered through the submitted solver/configuration workflow, not a two-file output shortcut.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: MPI source and submitted outputs support distributed execution, with no fresh rerun used to elevate credit.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: The Re200 production metadata accepts an unmet strict inner target, a material robustness failure.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight case directories structurally validate, but no evaluator build/rerun was performed and Re200 completion is invalid.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source is organized, while the report bundle deliberately omits required raw manifest input.
